query_surfaces.vrpentries: PREFERRED: path-aware, rollup-aware file and symlink query surface. Use for file-level searches that need full or relative paths via rpath(sname, sroll, name).
query_surfaces.vrsummary: PREFERRED: path-aware, rollup-aware directory summary query surface. Use for directory-level metadata and aggregate checks that need paths via rpath(sname, sroll).
query_surfaces.treesummary: PREFERRED: optional subtree aggregate table. Use with gufi_query -T to prune or summarize whole subtrees before scanning directory summaries or entries.
query_surfaces.vsummary{dir|user|group}: PREFERRED: filtered directory-local summary views. vsummarydir is the whole-directory row, vsummaryuser is per-user rows, and vsummarygroup is per-group rows when those rows have been generated.
query_surfaces.pentries: ADVANCED: file-level query surface with parent inode context but no path helper columns. Prefer vrpentries when paths or rollup-safe path reconstruction are needed.
query_surfaces.expentries: ADVANCED: runtime external-attach view over xpentries. Use when joining user-provided external databases to xattr-enhanced pentries rows; available during external database query setup.
query_surfaces.xsummary: ADVANCED: runtime xattr-enhanced summary view. Contains summary columns plus xattr_name and xattr_value; available when querying xattrs.
query_surfaces.entries: INTERNAL: raw file and symlink rows local to the current directory database. Prefer pentries or vrpentries for normal file queries, especially on rolled-up indexes.
query_surfaces.summary: INTERNAL: raw directory metadata and local aggregate rows. Prefer vrsummary or vsummary* views for model-facing queries and path-aware workflows.
query_surfaces.pentries_rollup: INTERNAL: storage table for child pentries copied into a parent during rollup. Query pentries or vrpentries instead.
query_surfaces.xattrs_pwd: INTERNAL: xattr name/value rows stored directly in the current database for entries whose xattrs can be rolled in under permission rules.
query_surfaces.xattrs_rollup: INTERNAL: xattr name/value rows copied up from child directories during rollup. Query xattr-enhanced views instead.
query_surfaces.external_dbs_pwd: INTERNAL: records external SQLite database files discovered in the current directory during indexing. Used by external attach and xattr permission handling.

vrpentries:
CREATE VIEW vrpentries AS SELECT REPLACE(vrsummary.name, RTRIM(vrsummary.name, REPLACE(vrsummary.name, '/', '')), '') AS dname, vrsummary.name AS sname, vrsummary.mode AS dmode, vrsummary.nlink AS dnlink, vrsummary.uid AS duid, vrsummary.gid AS dgid, vrsummary.size AS dsize, vrsummary.blksize AS dblksize, vrsummary.blocks AS dblocks, vrsummary.atime AS datime, vrsummary.mtime AS dmtime, vrsummary.ctime AS dctime, vrsummary.linkname AS dlinkname, vrsummary.totfiles AS dtotfiles, vrsummary.totlinks AS dtotlinks, vrsummary.minuid AS dminuid, vrsummary.maxuid AS dmaxuid, vrsummary.mingid AS dmingid, vrsummary.maxgid AS dmaxgid, vrsummary.minsize AS dminsize, vrsummary.maxsize AS dmaxsize, vrsummary.totzero AS dtotzero, vrsummary.totltk AS dtotltk, vrsummary.totmtk AS dtotmtk, vrsummary.totltm AS totltm, vrsummary.totmtm AS dtotmtm, vrsummary.totmtg AS dtotmtg, vrsummary.totmtt AS dtotmtt, vrsummary.totsize AS dtotsize, vrsummary.minctime AS dminctime, vrsummary.maxctime AS dmaxctime, vrsummary.totctime AS dtotctime, vrsummary.minmtime AS dminmtime, vrsummary.maxmtime AS dmaxmtime, vrsummary.totmtime AS dtotmtime, vrsummary.minatime AS dminatime, vrsummary.maxatime AS dmaxatime, vrsummary.totatime AS dtotatime, vrsummary.minblocks AS dminblocks, vrsummary.maxblocks AS dmaxblocks, vrsummary.totblocks AS dtotblocks, vrsummary.totxattr AS dtotxattr, vrsummary.depth AS ddepth, vrsummary.mincrtime AS dmincrtime, vrsummary.maxcrtime AS dmaxcrtime, vrsummary.totcrtime AS dtotcrtime, vrsummary.isrolledup AS sroll, vrsummary.isroot AS atroot, vrsummary.srollsubdirs AS srollsubdirs, pentries.* FROM vrsummary, pentries WHERE vrsummary.inode == pentries.pinode
/* vrpentries(dname,sname,dmode,dnlink,duid,dgid,dsize,dblksize,dblocks,datime,dmtime,dctime,dlinkname,dtotfiles,dtotlinks,dminuid,dmaxuid,dmingid,dmaxgid,dminsize,dmaxsize,dtotzero,dtotltk,dtotmtk,totltm,dtotmtm,dtotmtg,dtotmtt,dtotsize,dminctime,dmaxctime,dtotctime,dminmtime,dmaxmtime,dtotmtime,dminatime,dmaxatime,dtotatime,dminblocks,dmaxblocks,dtotblocks,dtotxattr,ddepth,dmincrtime,dmaxcrtime,dtotcrtime,sroll,atroot,srollsubdirs,name,type,inode,mode,nlink,uid,gid,size,blksize,blocks,atime,mtime,ctime,linkname,xattr_names,crtime,ossint1,ossint2,ossint3,ossint4,osstext1,osstext2,pinode,ppinode) */;
vrsummary: CREATE VIEW vrsummary AS SELECT REPLACE(summary.name, RTRIM(summary.name, REPLACE(summary.name, '/', '')), '') AS dname, summary.name AS sname, summary.isrolledup AS sroll, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM summary AS c WHERE c.pinode == summary.inode) AS srollsubdirs, summary.* FROM summary /* vrsummary(dname,sname,sroll,srollsubdirs,name,type,inode,mode,nlink,uid,gid,size,blksize,blocks,atime,mtime,ctime,linkname,xattr_names,crtime,totfiles,totlinks,minuid,maxuid,mingid,maxgid,minsize,maxsize,totzero,totltk,totmtk,totltm,totmtm,totmtg,totmtt,totsize,minctime,maxctime,totctime,minmtime,maxmtime,totmtime,minatime,maxatime,totatime,minblocks,maxblocks,totblocks,totxattr,depth,mincrtime,maxcrtime,totcrtime,minossint1,maxossint1,totossint1,minossint2,maxossint2,totossint2,minossint3,maxossint3,totossint3,minossint4,maxossint4,totossint4,rectype,pinode,isroot,canrollup,isrolledup) */;

vsummarydir: CREATE VIEW vsummarydir AS SELECT * FROM summary WHERE rectype == 0 /* vsummarydir(name,type,inode,mode,nlink,uid,gid,size,blksize,blocks,atime,mtime,ctime,linkname,xattr_names,crtime,totfiles,totlinks,minuid,maxuid,mingid,maxgid,minsize,maxsize,totzero,totltk,totmtk,totltm,totmtm,totmtg,totmtt,totsize,minctime,maxctime,totctime,minmtime,maxmtime,totmtime,minatime,maxatime,totatime,minblocks,maxblocks,totblocks,totxattr,depth,mincrtime,maxcrtime,totcrtime,minossint1,maxossint1,totossint1,minossint2,maxossint2,totossint2,minossint3,maxossint3,totossint3,minossint4,maxossint4,totossint4,rectype,pinode,isroot,canrollup,isrolledup) */;
vsummaryuser: CREATE VIEW vsummaryuser AS SELECT * FROM summary WHERE rectype == 1 /* vsummaryuser(name,type,inode,mode,nlink,uid,gid,size,blksize,blocks,atime,mtime,ctime,linkname,xattr_names,crtime,totfiles,totlinks,minuid,maxuid,mingid,maxgid,minsize,maxsize,totzero,totltk,totmtk,totltm,totmtm,totmtg,totmtt,totsize,minctime,maxctime,totctime,minmtime,maxmtime,totmtime,minatime,maxatime,totatime,minblocks,maxblocks,totblocks,totxattr,depth,mincrtime,maxcrtime,totcrtime,minossint1,maxossint1,totossint1,minossint2,maxossint2,totossint2,minossint3,maxossint3,totossint3,minossint4,maxossint4,totossint4,rectype,pinode,isroot,canrollup,isrolledup) */;
vsummarygroup: CREATE VIEW vsummarygroup AS SELECT * FROM summary WHERE rectype == 2 /* vsummarygroup(name,type,inode,mode,nlink,uid,gid,size,blksize,blocks,atime,mtime,ctime,linkname,xattr_names,crtime,totfiles,totlinks,minuid,maxuid,mingid,maxgid,minsize,maxsize,totzero,totltk,totmtk,totltm,totmtm,totmtg,totmtt,totsize,minctime,maxctime,totctime,minmtime,maxmtime,totmtime,minatime,maxatime,totatime,minblocks,maxblocks,totblocks,totxattr,depth,mincrtime,maxcrtime,totcrtime,minossint1,maxossint1,totossint1,minossint2,maxossint2,totossint2,minossint3,maxossint3,totossint3,minossint4,maxossint4,totossint4,rectype,pinode,isroot,canrollup,isrolledup) */;
pentries: CREATE VIEW pentries AS SELECT entries.*, summary.inode AS pinode, summary.pinode AS ppinode FROM entries, summary WHERE isroot == 1 UNION SELECT * FROM pentries_rollup /* pentries(name,type,inode,mode,nlink,uid,gid,size,blksize,blocks,atime,mtime,ctime,linkname,xattr_names,crtime,ossint1,ossint2,ossint3,ossint4,osstext1,osstext2,pinode,ppinode) */;
expentries: CREATE TEMP VIEW expentries AS SELECT * FROM xpentries /* expentries(name,type,inode,mode,nlink,uid,gid,size,blksize,blocks,atime,mtime,ctime,linkname,xattr_names,crtime,ossint1,ossint2,ossint3,ossint4,osstext1,osstext2,pinode,ppinode,xattr_name,xattr_value) */;
xsummary: CREATE TEMP VIEW xsummary AS SELECT summary.*, xattrs.name AS xattr_name, xattrs.value AS xattr_value FROM summary LEFT JOIN xattrs ON summary.inode == xattrs.inode /* xsummary(name,type,inode,mode,nlink,uid,gid,size,blksize,blocks,atime,mtime,ctime,linkname,xattr_names,crtime,totfiles,totlinks,minuid,maxuid,mingid,maxgid,minsize,maxsize,totzero,totltk,totmtk,totltm,totmtm,totmtg,totmtt,totsize,minctime,maxctime,totctime,minmtime,maxmtime,totmtime,minatime,maxatime,totatime,minblocks,maxblocks,totblocks,totxattr,depth,mincrtime,maxcrtime,totcrtime,minossint1,maxossint1,totossint1,minossint2,maxossint2,totossint2,minossint3,maxossint3,totossint3,minossint4,maxossint4,totossint4,rectype,pinode,isroot,canrollup,isrolledup,xattr_name,xattr_value) */;
